prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a COMPOSITION EDIT of the single attached Asmongold illustration for a premium collectible card. Preserve its established hand-drawn anime style, expressive character likeness, clothing, scene, gesture, objects, atmosphere and rarity colour palette. The user likes the style and wants it composed to suit a known card layout. Reframe by pulling the camera back moderately (about 18 percent) and arranging the existing subject LOWER so the ENTIRE top of his hair/head starts approximately 18 percent down the image. There must be real illustrated environment above his hair, at least 15 percent of total image height; do not leave his head at the top or crop his hair. Face stays substantial and readable, about 22-26 percent of image height; head and beard fit roughly between y=18 and y=48 percent. Top left x=0-35 percent and top right x=76-100 percent, both y=0-15 percent, are reserved for later branding, so fill them with subdued environmental detail only, no faces or key props. The core scene, expressive hands and defining object must be legible within y=22-74 percent. Lower y=77-100 percent will receive a title and bottom-right QR later: paint coherent naturally darker environment in that lower zone, with no key fingers, faces or crucial objects there. Do not draw a box, gradient overlay, badge or any layout markings; this is finished FULL-BLEED ART ONLY. Keep confident variable-weight black ink contours, grouped hair locks, graphic beard, 2-3 cel-shaded skin tones, restrained hatching, expressive drawn eyes, cinematic shonen composition. No photographic skin, no glossy 3D, no extreme caricature. Preserve recognizable Asmongold: high receding hairline, long scruffy brown hair, thin elongated face, long nose, strong eyebrows and brown beard. No body bulk increase or generic handsome hero replacement. Output ONE portrait illustration with 5:7 proportions, about 1024x1440; complete illustration extends to all edges. Absolutely no lettering, numbers, QR code, logos, crown, watermark, frame, border, title, or signature. Do not recreate the card interface. Keep his three-quarter wondering face toward the huge luminous ice-blue crystal in the fantasy city, original beginner adventurer outfit. Shift his entire hair/face lower within the left half so top of hair starts at y=18 percent and face ends around y=49 percent. The crystal remains spectacular in upper/middle right but the top-right header zone has subdued sky/architecture. His extended hand must be fully visible around middle-left y=53-70 percent, not near bottom-right. Crowd and pale stone city remain visible below the crystal; bottom can be shadowed steps and small crowd silhouettes. No king regalia or recognizable franchise character.

previous_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE portrait collectible-card illustration, 1024x1536. Create exceptionally strong original modern shonen manga illustration: decisive black brush ink, bold cel-shaded planes, expressive hand-drawn face, subtle halftone, cinematic perspective, controlled painterly background; premium illustrated trading card, never a photograph, never glossy 3D. Subject is recognisably the real streamer ASMONGOLD (Zack): pale lean man, thin elongated face, high receding hairline, long unkempt medium-brown hair falling past shoulders, distinctive very expressive thick brows, long pointed nose, scruffy brown beard/moustache, wiry build. Preserve his real facial character rather than making him a generic handsome anime hero. His face should occupy at least a quarter of image height and be clearly visible. Keep his face, hands and key object within the central 80 percent width, upper 75 percent height. Full bleed art only; artwork extends across the image. Absolutely NO typography, words, letters, numbers, signatures, logos, crowns, branding, card frame, borders, QR codes, watermarks or UI. This is an imaginative editorial illustration of a real video subject, not a literal historical reconstruction. All costume, environment and fantastical creatures are original designs, do not copy a particular anime, artist or exact video-game asset. Scene: the experienced MMO streamer becomes a beginner in a new world, inspired by his first Final Fantasy XIV stream. Asmongold in original simple beginner adventurer clothes with light leather shoulder straps, clearly his high forehead, long loose brown hair and scruffy beard; no grand crown or king regalia. Large three-quarter close face turned toward an enormous luminous faceted crystal suspended in a distant fantasy city. His eyes widen and mouth opens slightly in genuine wonder, one hand extended toward the light. A crowd of small varied ORIGINAL adventurer silhouettes welcomes him below, carved pale stone walkways, bright sky. Dramatic spatial depth. Brilliant bone-white and ice-cyan crystal light with restrained pink/violet spectral edges against dense black ink. Light draws him into an unfamiliar world; openness and discovery rather than combat or omnipotence. Spectacular crystal refractions reserved around the environment; keep human face warm and clearly readable. Not a copy of a specific FF city, character, logo or outfit.
